articles.title: This Robot Rolls Up Like an Armadillo to Save Your Gadgets
articles.summary: What if a robot could curl into a ball like an armadillo to protect itself? Engineers built one that does exactly that. When touched, it rolls up in about a minute to guard fragile electronics.

articles.title: Fat Bear Week: Vote for the Chubbiest Bear in Alaska!
articles.summary: It's Fat Bear Week! Every year, people vote for the fattest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. This year, 16 bears are competing. More than 1.7 million votes came from over 100 countries last year.

articles.title: This 14-Year-Old Started a Nonprofit to Teach Kids Coding
articles.summary: Meet Abhijay Potluri, a 14-year-old who started a nonprofit called Kids Who Teach. He also helped raise money for families after a fire near his home. He says kids can make real change.
